provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Food Chain Magnate rules overview (Splotter Spellen, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Lay out the employee and milestone cards, removing some employee types by player count
Build a map of randomly drawn, randomly rotated tiles (size by player count)
Each player: a CEO card, 3 restaurants and 3 bank reserve cards
Bank: {n} dollars; players start with no money
Random turn order; from last to first, each player places one starting restaurant (entrance on a road, not sharing a tile entrance)
Each player secretly chooses one bank reserve card
